These are now ## eligible for the analysis. sum_mcmc <- summary(mcmc_pp, burnin = 0, thin = 1) print(sum_mcmc, which = "group_param", clusters = 1, pattern = "ntrips") ## ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Chain 1 ## ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ##  ## Summary of the parameter estimates ## ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Parameters specific for cluster g=1: ##                            Effect        2.5%         25%         50%       Mean ## beta_poi_ntrips(1)[1] (Intercept) -1.31467038 -1.18195651 -1.13156031 -1.1368997 ## beta_poi_ntrips(1)[2]         age  0.07480618  0.07715431  0.07854806  0.0785877 ##                               75%       97.5% ## beta_poi_ntrips(1)[1] -1.07528402 -0.98680941 ## beta_poi_ntrips(1)[2]  0.07982884  0.08324393 print(mcmc_pp, which = "clustering") ## ## Clustering based on sampled indicators: ## ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Chain 1 ## ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ## The most-frequent number of non-empty components: 3 ## Empty components:  ## Non-empty components: 1, 2, 3 ##   1   2   3  ## 144 151 205  ## Average certainty of assignment to a component:  ##         1         2         3  ## 0.9694069 0.9754788 0.9994580 psurvey$Uclustering <- mcmc_pp$clustering[psurvey$i, 1] par(mar = c(4, 4, 1, 0.5), mfrow = c(1, 3)) plot_num_vs_x_grouped(psurvey, "income", x = "age",  id = "i", group = "Uclustering",                       add_lowess = TRUE, legend_placement = "topleft") plot_num_vs_x_grouped(psurvey, "ntrips", x = "age",  id = "i", group = "Uclustering",                       add_lowess = TRUE, legend_placement = "topleft") plot_cat_vs_x_grouped(psurvey, "satisfaction", x = "age", group = "Uclustering")

title: Model-Based Clustering of Mixed-Type Longitudinal Data — clustGLMM-package
text: Provides tools Bayesian estimation inference modelling clusterwise multivariate regression models numeric, count, binary, ordinal count outcomes observed repeatedly units possible relations among outcomes captured joint distribution random effects. clusters defined cluster-specific parameters, analyst can choose, e.g., respect regression coefficients. particular, model specification regression model via formula specific outcome consists four parts: (1) fixed - regression coefficients common clusters, (2) group - group-specific regression coefficients, (3) random - random effects specific unit, (3) offset - name offset variable (needed). Estimation performed using MCMC sampling combining Gibbs Metropolis-Hastings steps. Post-processing tools allow assess convergence address label switching provide visual diagnostics. Units may classified based sampled allocation indicators exploiting posterior distribution classification probabilities. details see Vavra et al. (2024) <doi:10.1007/s11222-023-10304-5>.

title: Print the Output of clustGLMM — print.clustglmm
text: First, "call" , prints x$call summarizes   fitted including sample sizes, number units, observations per unit,   chosen maximal number clusters, overview outcomes selected types,   fixed-effects common groups, random-effects structure Sigma matrix,   group-specific formulae outcomes, list group-specific parameters summary MCMC sampling. Next, "clustering" ,   summarizes clustering based sampled indicators U chain separately.   First, modeGplus, frequent value Gplus - number non-empty components, determined.   , samples cluster indicators U gathered units determine modeGplus frequent cluster labels, stored clusters.   unit assign cluster label clusters maximizes frequency samples U[], stored clustering.   also keep relative frequency assigned cluster, stored certainty.   choosing reasonable threshold, e.g. 0.5, can make unit unclassified (0) certainty high enough: clustering[certainty < threshold] <- 0.   G = 1, clustering summary irrelevant.

title: Rescale the Raw Draws — rescale_matrix
text: Regression coefficients divided corresponding scale scales, except intercept parameters. shifted corresponding linear combination centers given rescaled coefficients. Parameters numeric outcomes also account rescaling outcome variable. ordinal outcomes, intercepts included among regressors, carried ordered intercepts c_ord reparametrizations. Also random effects including covariance matrix (related parameters) rescaled. details paper.

title: Compute the Summary Statistics of clustGLMM Output — summary.clustglmm
text: object object class "clustglmm" (returned function clustGLMM). burnin length burn-period (default 0), .e., number initial samples omit. thin thinning rate (default 1); every thinth value kept (must positive integer). x object class "summary.clustglmm" (returned summary method "clustglmm" objects) . character vector indicates summaries printed. chains vector chain numbers print summary results . clusters list cluster labels group-specific parameters printed chain; missing x$clusters used. pattern pattern used matching grep among parameter names include summary, empty string default (.e., matches names selected category). max_nchar_details maximal number characters details printed additional column, longer last three characters replaced "...". lower 4, column details added. ... arguments passed methods.

title: Compute the Summary Statistics of clustGLMM Output — summary.clustglmm
text: print.summary prints summary chain selected argument chains.   Depending selected argument, following summaries printed: mcmc overview sampled chains, accept evolution (samples divided 4 segments) average proposal acceptance grouped parameter type, clustering summary clustering, inv_param cluster-invariant parameters, clust_param clustering-related parameters (Gplus, e0, w), latent_param latent parameters (random effects b, allocation indicators U, missing outcome values naY), group_param group-specific parameters. Regarding clustering option noted   summary based sampled allocation indicators using   raw output clustGLMM, based   approximated clustering probabilities output   clustering_probabilities_and_deviance. printing summary parameters, argument   pattern allows reduce list printed parameters.   Group-specific parameters printed cluster labels   clusters.  default, parameters non-empty clusters   printed.  output summary contains   coda-like tables ("statistics" "quantiles"),   combination two printed (quantiles   mean).

title: Compute the Summary Statistics of clustGLMM Output — summary.clustglmm
text: summary returns list : call string describing model defined estimated, G maximal number clusters, modeGplus frequent number non-empty clusters per chain, clustering matrix assigned clusters unit based sampled indicators, certainty matrix certainties (highest clustering probability among G ) unit based sampled indicators, clusters labels non-empty clusters chain separately, coda_summary output coda summary chain separately, output type output summarized: mcmc samples clustGLMM, probs approximation clustering probabilities deviance clustering_probabilities_and_deviance, fnames vector parameter names invariant clustering, gnames cluster-specific parameter names cluster 1, lnames latent variable names (allocation indicators, random effects, missing values), cnames clustering related parameter names, effect_names details model parameter added summary table max_nchar_details > 3, accept_summary list column means standard deviations object$accept evolution grouped average acceptance parameter names, chain separately.
